marc:datafield.marc:subfield: This drama shows the passions of young people who dream of being the best idol stars and their love story. Their challenge and the taste thrill of the reality of the reality of Survival Audition and idol's splendid performance is highly impressive. CEO Jang manages the first entertainment company in Korea entitled 'Sunny Entertainment' and makes up a group named <M2>. Eight members of <M2 Junior> are selected in the audition and have to perform in a concert on the stage of their exclusive theatre once a month in order to be the formal member of <M2>. They came through a competition of 6,500 to be the final 8 members of <M2> and challenged the Survival Audition to become the formal members.
